body.statement: The spectral-separation condition in VMW Assumption 3 requires the conditional treatment effects to be mutually distinct across latent classes, and VMW Theorem 7.2 assumes spectral separation for its finite-sample feature-matrix and mixture-weight recovery guarantee.

source.verbatim_statement: The conditional treatment effects are mutually distinct across latent classes. Assume Assumption 2, strict latent positivity, Assumption 4, and spectral separation.

attestation.note: Transcribed from Assumption 3 and the hypothesis line of Theorem 7.2 in the arXiv HTML for version 1.
